question.text: SEBI's Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF), 2024 applies to AIFs. A cyber-incident (data breach) occurs at Ashoka Credit AIF. What is the SEBI-mandated timeline for reporting the incident to the sector regulator and central government?

answer.text: Within 6 hours of noticing or being brought to attention of the incident
Annually, in the Compliance Test Report

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI's CSCRF, cyber and security incidents must be reported to the sector regulator and central government within 6 hours of noticing or being brought to attention. SEBI CSCRF also categorises AIF managers into qualified, mid-size, small-size and self-certification regulated entities, with governance and reporting obligations flowing accordingly. The Trap: Option B (30 days) is an audit cadence, not an incident-reporting deadline. Option C (48 hours) is not the CSCRF window. Option D (annual) is incorrect — cyber incidents are immediate-reporting events. Note: Workbook page 140 states the 6-hour reporting requirement; pages 250-251 support the CSCRF categorisation context for AIF managers.
